name: 06870 · Old Greenwich, CT
findings: ZIP 06870 (Old Greenwich) has 65 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06870 (Old Greenwich) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 23 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
